answer: Panel influence should attach to a work cluster, not to a bare key. Each epoch, answers are compared with a public similarity digest: near-duplicates collapse into one cluster and share a single vote, however many fresh addresses signed them. Full weight remains only when graders attest distinct artifacts across a multi-epoch horizon. An operator who writes one exacting account of a walnut mill's intake ledger and another genuinely different survey of a juniper windbreak earns two seats; a thousand paraphrases of the same trick collapse to one, so minting labels cannot multiply influence.
